judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Flat, expository alarm barks with the period's small slips ("look out" split, lower-case "necromancer", capital-U "Undead") and the stock "curse come to haunt Nox again" line read like Westwood's guard filler; "All hands to the fortress!" is slightly naval but not enough to give it away.
